meta.title: OnetCli
meta.description: A native all-in-one workspace for databases, SSH, SFTP, terminals, remote desktop, monitoring, and AI.

home.title: OnetCli
home.subtitle: Manage databases, SSH, SFTP, terminals, remote desktop, monitoring, and AI workflows from one native app. Team management and shared connections keep collaboration in the same workspace.
subtitleLines: Manage databases, SSH, SFTP, terminals, remote desktop, monitoring, and AI workflows from one native app.
Team management and shared connections keep collaboration in the same workspace.
home.capabilitiesTitle: One workspace from connections to data work
home.capabilitiesCopy: OnetCli is built for developers and operations teams who connect to databases, servers, logs, files, SQL, and data every day. Keep fewer windows open and keep frequent work in one context.

capabilities.title: Multi-database queries
capabilities.copy: Manage MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Oracle, ClickHouse, Redis, MongoDB, and more, then jump into schemas, queries, and data views quickly.

capabilities.title: SSH, SFTP, and terminals
capabilities.copy: Open terminals, browse remote files, drag files to upload or download, and finish common server work from the same app.

capabilities.title: AI-assisted SQL and data work
capabilities.copy: Generate SQL, explain query results, and shape data analysis without constantly switching between database tools, docs, and chat windows.

capabilities.title: Remote desktop and shared connections
capabilities.copy: Manage RDP, VNC, Serial, and shared team resources in one place so members can work around the same set of connections.

home.featuresCopy: OnetCli brings connection management, data queries, remote terminals, and AI assistance into one native app, reducing context switching.
home.teamCopy: Create teams, invite members, and share common connections with collaborators. The desktop app remains the place for connection work and local workflows.
home.ctaTitle: Ready to manage your team workspace?
home.ctaCopy: Create an account, set up a team, invite members, and share common connections.

features.databaseCopy: Connect MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, DuckDB, SQL Server, Oracle, ClickHouse, and extension drivers.
features.sshCopy: Open remote terminals, browse files, drag files to upload, and edit remote files directly.
features.aiCopy: Generate SQL, explain queries, analyze data, and turn results into charts.
features.teamCopy: Manage members and shared connections so the team can work from one workspace.

dashboard.title: Team console
dashboard.subtitle: Manage teams, members, invitations, and roles. Desktop sync data stays encrypted and is not decrypted or modified by the website.
